theme_strategy: Light Theme ONLY. Emphasizing 'Myntra-inspired' bright, clean, premium e-commerce aesthetics with large whitespace, minimalistic layouts, and product-first presentation.

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, H3, large display numbers (Manifesto chapters)
primary_heading.styling: Tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for large headings, bold contrast.

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation, product titles, metadata, buttons
body.styling: Clean, readable, neutral color. Tracking normal or slightly loose for small uppercase labels.

colors.accents: Use the brand colors sparingly as accent lines, hover states, 'Add to Cart' buttons, or sale tags. Do not use gradients of these colors.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use `py-24`, `py-32` for sections to create breathing room.
layouts_and_grids.product_grid: High density, 2 columns on mobile, 3 to 4 columns on desktop. `gap-4` or `gap-8`.
layouts_and_grids.product_cards: Image aspect ratio MUST be `aspect-[3/4]` with `object-cover`. Soft rounded corners (`rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl`) with subtle hover shadow.
layouts_and_grids.hero_section: Large kinetic hero. White space heavy. Headline centered or dynamically aligned. Includes a masked line-by-line reveal animation on load.
layouts_and_grids.manifesto_section: Numbered chapters. Extremely large typographic numbers in `text-brand-magenta` paired with clean minimal text.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scrolling: MANDATORY: Use `@studio-freight/lenis` for premium momentum smooth scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: MANDATORY: Line-by-line text reveal using `framer-motion`. Parent `overflow-hidden`, child `motion.div` animates `y: "100%"` to `y: 0` with a spring transition.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Include at least one parallax section (e.g., in the manifesto or a banner image) where the background moves slower than the scroll.
motion_and_interactions.editorial_marquee: MANDATORY: A slow-moving editorial ribbon separating sections using `react-fast-marquee`. Low contrast, uppercase serif or mono text.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Magnetic feeling buttons or slight scale up (`hover:scale-[1.02]`) on product cards.

components.header: Sticky navigation, `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80`. Must include a visible logo, Men/Women links, Cart icon (triggering drawer), and User/Login icon.
components.cart_drawer: Use Shadcn `Sheet` component for a slide-out cart. Show items, total, and checkout button.
components.product_page: Spotlight product imagery (clipped frames, clean grey or white backgrounds). Size selector (toggle group or simple buttons). 'Add to Cart' CTA in bold brand color.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or smooth rounded (`rounded-lg`). High contrast. E.g., `bg-[#F41CB2] text-white hover:bg-[#F25511] transition-colors`.

hero_images.description: Fashion-forward woman in chic outfit, used for main banner or women's category.
Stylish man with newsboy cap, used for men's category banner.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum WCAG AA standards. If putting white text on the pink/orange buttons, verify contrast is adequate, otherwise use dark text.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="add-to-cart-btn"`, `data-testid="category-mens"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup global styles in index.css importing Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts.
2. Configure Tailwind with the specified brand colors and custom fonts.
3. Build a layout with a fixed blurred header containing Men/Women links and a Cart trigger.
4. Implement the Hero Section: A highly kinetic, typography-heavy block. Use `framer-motion` for a staggered, line-by-line reveal of the headline. Include a subtle parallax image.
5. Add a `react-fast-marquee` band scrolling slowly below the hero featuring brand keywords or a manifesto intro.
6. Build a Product Grid Section. Use the provided images. Cards must have `aspect-[3/4]` sizing, minimalistic design, subtle hover shadows, and clean pricing typography.
7. Build a Manifesto Section: Create a multi-chapter narrative. Use huge numbered steps (e.g., '01', '02') paired with short text. Use framer-motion to fade these in on scroll.
8. Integrate a mocked 'Cart Drawer' and 'Google Login / Razorpay' flow using Shadcn components (Sheet for cart, Dialog for login).
9. Wrap the entire app or main scrolling container in Lenis for premium smooth scrolling.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
NEVER use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Always use the provided image URLs. Missing images lead to placeholder text which is forbidden.
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
